Thanks. I went through the code before replying, because I'd rather not ask what it already answers.

**Our flags applied on the old build too.** On our old pin, https://github.com/gufo-org/gufo/commit/b722a615df87a556a3e87109017cb4d0e9344061, `serve.cpp` passes the CLI `sampling_config` to `set_sampling_defaults(...)`, and `openai_chat.cpp` parses each request's sampling fields over `output->sampling`, which starts from those defaults. So a request that omits sampling fields got our `--temperature 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --top-k 20 --min-p 0.0` on that build as well as on 0.5.0. We were not greedy before https://github.com/gufo-org/gufo/pull/282 and sampled after; both builds sampled for us.

**An omitted repetition penalty is the neutral value.** `SamplingConfig` in `src/core/sampling.hpp` defaults `repeat_penalty` to 1.0 (and `repeat_last_n` to 64), `ResolveTextSampling` in `src/core/text_sampling_defaults.hpp` leaves it at that for Qwen3.8 with thinking on, and https://github.com/gufo-org/gufo/issues/277 lists repetition penalty 1.0 for that row. So not passing one does not put us on a different sampler from the preset. A value above 1.0 would be an extra setting, not a missing one.

That leaves the effective sampling the same on both builds as far as I can read, and the acceptance drop in https://github.com/gufo-org/gufo/issues/475 (6.1 points lower, with 36% more draft tokens proposed) still needs another cause. I may be missing something, so one question: is there a change between `b722a61` and 0.5.0 other than the defaults that could affect how many draft tokens are proposed or accepted for Flash-Next MTP at temperature 1.0? I can bisect the range on our hardware if that helps, but I'd rather not spend days of runs if you can name the likely commit.

If you do think a repetition penalty above 1.0 raises acceptance, tell me the value and whether verification still preserves the target distribution with it. We would run that as a separate series rather than change the settings mid-series.
